events.label: Alexandr Wang profile and Meta AI leadership

slots.name: Instagram followers
slots.sentence: He’s a native of the social-media ecosystem his boss built, boasting nearly one million followers on Instagram, where he posts photos with everyone from his friend actress Kiernan Shipka to OpenAI CEO Sam Altman to French President Emmanuel Macron.

slots.name: Wang age
slots.sentence: Wang, 29, is the company’s first senior executive from Gen Z, bringing an internet-flavored communication style that could help it connect with younger consumers.

slots.name: MIT courses
slots.sentence: In 2015, he enrolled at MIT and took five graduate computer science courses as a freshman.
